Tumhare chart ki wo smooth line kya hai, aur SMA ya EMA me kaunsi pehle mudti hai? 📚 KNOW #12
Chart pe wo smooth line kya hai jo price ke peeche chalti hai?
• Moving average = pichhli kuch candles ka ausat price.
• SMA har candle ko barabar wazan deta hai.
• EMA nayi candles ko zyada wazan deta hai, isliye jaldi mudta hai.
Tip: moving average peeche chalti hai. Ye trend dikhati hai, bhavishya nahi.
